description: The bar chart titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks” illustrates benchmark scores for two models across multiple datasets/metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmarks labeled (left to right) GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with labels angled diagonally; the axis label is “Dataset and Metrics.” The vertical axis is a linear scale labeled “Score (%)” ranging from 0 to 80 with regularly spaced tick marks at 10-point intervals. Each category shows a pair of adjacent bars: a blue bar for “LLaMA-3-8B-it” and an orange bar for “Ours (Iterative RLHF),” as indicated by the legend titled “Model” in the upper right. Approximate bar heights are: GSM-8K ~80 (blue) and ~80 (orange); MMLU ~65 (blue) and ~65 (orange); HumanEval ~61 (blue) and ~64 (orange); TruthfulQA ~44 (blue) and ~60 (orange); ARC ~59 (blue) and ~64 (orange); MBPP ~61 (blue) and ~61 (orange); LC AlpacaEval-2 ~23 (blue) and ~31 (orange); MT-Bench (×5) ~40 (blue) and ~42 (orange); Chat-Arena-Hard ~20 (blue) and ~29 (orange). The bars are grouped by benchmark (two bars per group) and are not visually stacked; there is no explicit sorting cue beyond the left-to-right listing, and no bars appear specially emphasized with outlines or annotations.
